title: Syslog error for Unexpected running containers: gbsyncd
author: sacnaik
body:

#### Description
During bootup sonic syslog throw following container check errors 

Error message - 'container_checker' status failed (4) -- Unexpected running containers: gbsyncd

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
The SONiC monit service looks up FEATURE table from CONFIG DB and actual running container service to match all the expected containers are up and running.  Since gbsyncd feature is not added in the FEATURE table, monit service throw syslog errors about "Unexpected running container"

The default init config init_cfg.json.j2  adds gbsyncd into CONFIGDB for only virtual switch.
For real hardware platform the CONFIGDB update is missing.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1.  Build image for gbsyncd enabled platform 
2. Boot system and ensure gbsyncd container is running(via docker ps command)
3. Check syslog for the error.

#### Describe the results you received:
Once gbsyncd container starts monit service reporting unexpected container error
'container_checker' status failed (4) -- Unexpected running containers: gbsyncd

#### Describe the results you expected:
The error message should not be present in the syslog when gbsyncd container runs.

Fix [#10501](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/10501)
Fix [#9733](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/9733)

If having gearbox, we need
- add gbsyncd as a peer since swss also has dependency on gbsyncd
- add service gbsyncd to FEATURE table if it is missing
